integrity: Symbolic proof for all part sizes; included finite checker supports but does not replace proof; independently unvalidated.
scientific_limitations: Only complete bipartite item graphs, nonempty connected bundles, one through the number of vertices agents. Low-band ordinary EF1 is prior; high-band EF1_outer is the newly derived algorithm; full text of one recent related source was unavailable.
title: Exact connected EF1 spectrum of complete bipartite graphs under arbitrary monotone valuations
